critique: The note proves identification, pointwise inference for a feasible joint estimator, and an exact equality criterion and variance-gap formula within the fixed constant span of retained pairwise DDD scores. The optimization and quadratic frontier are finite-dimensional GMM/SUR projection algebra, so the DDD-specific contribution is chiefly the shared-cell covariance mapping and its implementation rather than a new general efficiency theory. This is too narrow for field or flagship status because it neither characterizes the full conditional-moment efficiency bound nor establishes uniform attainability, coverage, or inference for the estimated variance gap. The TL;DR, introduction, and project justification accurately confine their claims to this constant-score-span result; no stated conjecture or one-sided result is presented as solved.
